steps.description:
Create a program that asks the user to enter an integer. If the number is equal to 5, display "is 5".

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input

9

-5

5

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input integer: 9

Example 2 Input integer: -5

Example 3 Input integer: 5 is 5

Create a program that asks the user to enter an integer. If the number is not equal to 5, display "not 5".

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input

9

-5

5

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input integer: 9 not 5

Example 2 Input integer: -5 not 5

Example 3 Input integer: 5

Create a program that asks the user to enter an integer. If the number is less than 10, display "less than 10".

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input

11

10

9

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input integer: 11

Example 2 Input integer: 10

Example 3 Input integer: 9 less than 10

Create a program that asks the user to enter an integer. If the number is less than or equal to 10, display "less than or equal to 10". Use only one if statement.

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input

11

10

9

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input integer: 11

Example 2 Input integer: 10 less than or equal to 10

Example 3 Input integer: 9 less than or equal to 10

Create a program that asks the user to enter 2 integers in a row. Use split() to separate the integers. If the first integer is less than the second, display "first is smaller".

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input

10 9

9 9

9 10

10 11

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input 2 integers: 10 9

Example 2 Input 2 integers: 9 9

Example 3 Input 2 integers: 9 10 first is smaller

Example 4 Input 2 integers: 10 11 first is smaller

Example 3 Input 2 integers: 9 10

Example 4 Input 2 integers: 10 11
